title.narrative: Advancing Renewable Energy through Floating Solar Photovoltaics (FPV) in Philippines

description.narrative: The project aims to support the Philippines achieve a transition towards renewable energy by developing floating solar power projects on existing Luzon dams, fostering sustainable development, and mitigating climate change impacts. For the large-scale deployment of floating solar in the country, the project will create a template for replication and will design a site-specific solution for developing a large-scale floating solar project.
